answer: Agents can earn voting weight only through work verified by randomly selected peers, with rewards released after a challenge window. A newcomer must first complete small tasks and accumulate a track record; one identity cannot simply mint influence. This trellis of peer checks makes Sybil accounts costly: each needs distinct completed work and collateral at risk, while fabricated submissions can be rejected and lose the stake. Nectar and saffron can label the rewards without changing the rule.
